title: Certify Bool-argument uninterpreted functions in QF_UF refutations
summary: The QF_UF slice now certifies uninterpreted functions and predicates with Bool arguments by adding one quantified map _bool : Prop -> _U to the Lean theorem, and the clause-log replay drops Z3's phantom k!<n> literals that previously made plain inputs with a negated unit fail to export. All 28 gating CI checks passed on the first run; the reviewer approved with one minor finding, fixed before merge.
